 Robert Pattinson's Primetime on OTT: Where and how to watch the thriller inspired by To Catch a Predator
 SECTIONS Robert Pattinson's Primetime on OTT: Where and how to watch the thriller inspired by To Catch a Predator By ET Entertainment Desk , Last Updated: Nov 08, 2026, 11:18:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Chris Hansen, former host of To Catch a Predator, has criticised Primetime, the Robert Pattinson-led thriller inspired by investigations featured on his show. In a September 25 post on X, Hansen described the film as “bizarre” and “in and out of reality”, saying its portrayal felt detached from his actual experiences.
 Chris Hansen calls Robert Pattinson's Primetime “bizarre”, saying the film's portrayal is detached from reality.
 Robert Pattinson’s Primetime is now available for digital streaming, less than two months after its theatrical release. The based-on-a-true-story thriller stars Robert Pattinson as To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen. It dramatises the events surrounding the show, which turned criminal justice into a spectacle, as Hansen aims to make television history before the most high-stakes sting the show has attempted goes horribly wrong.
 Primetime is an American psychological thriller written by Ajon Singh and directed by Lance Oppenheim. The film dramatises the reality TV series To Catch a Predator. Robert Pattinson leads the drama as journalist Chris Hansen, who works with a vigilante group to nab child predators through sting operations. The movie also features Merritt Wever, Skyler Gisondo, Matthew Maher and Phoebe Bridgers in supporting roles.
The movie premiered at the 83rd Venice International Film Festival on September 5 and hit theatres in the US on September 25. It has received positive reviews from critics. 
 Where to stream Robert Pattinson’s movie on OTT?
Primetime arrived on digital streaming through premium video on demand (PVOD) on November 3 in the US. In addition to Prime Video, the movie is available to purchase for $24.99 on various digital platforms, including Apple TV , Fandango at Home and YouTube Movies & TV.
Since rental prices are typically $5 lower than purchase prices, Primetime is expected to be available to rent for $19.99 on PVOD for a 48-hour viewing period. It is not yet available for streaming in India. 
 What did Robert Pattison say about Chris Hansen?
Speaking with Entertainment Weekly during a screening of the film at the BFI London Film Festival, Pattinson admitted that he had tried to make Hansen look "cool", adding that he was a fan of the journalist himself. He explained that what one person considers cool may not appeal to everyone.
 The actor also recalled seeing young audiences turn up at screenings dressed as Hansen and imitate him. He found it exciting that viewers of the same age at which he first discovered Hansen were now revisiting his work and learning about his important contributions.
 What did Hansen say about Primetime?
In a Friday, September 25 post on X, former To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen shared a clip from his podcast and YouTube channel, in which he reviewed Primetime, the Robert Pattinson-led film based on real events from his show. After scrutinising the project for weeks, Hansen described the film as “bizarre” and “in and out of reality”.
Speaking outside a movie theatre, Hansen acknowledged that he was not an objective viewer because the character portrayed in the film was based on him. However, he felt the story was detached from reality and bore little resemblance to anything he had experienced during his investigations, either then or now. He also admitted that he was unsure what the film was trying to convey.
